description: Group of Colegio Internacional de Sevilla San Francisco de Paula students that are reshaping the future.
summary: Our project is a 3d space videogame that shows how a real space mission is formed. You can choose your team, your rocket and its features and also the mission. there are different levels all full of creative and interactive games in different parts of the universe. It is perfect for people that love the space and want to have fun learning.
details: You only need wifi to download it, then you can play without it. Its benefits are it's very creative, also you learn a lot with the Nasa data and the missions. The impact is it tells the future astronaut generation how a real space mission is and new facts about the space. It uses HTML and JAVA. It is creative because it is new and also it is educational and it with Nasa facts tells about missions. Doing more levels and put more facts. We had a lot of failed versions till we founde the correct videogame.
